checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same sneaker in original side view, fully in frame
must.why: Same pose and framing, fully inside.
Stitching, eyelets, laces and sole remain, though the interior collar was redrawn cream and the sole looks creamier.

must.item: Grey floor and clutter replaced by seamless white setting
must.why: Clutter is gone and the background is seamless, but it is light grey, not white. Matches the assistant's stated grey, not the must-have.

must.item: Soft shadow grounds the sneaker without visible floor boundary
must.why: Soft shadow under the shoe, no horizon line.
Same wide frame as the input, no text.

faults.what: Background is light grey, not white as the must-have requires.
Shoe interior and heel collar redrawn as cream, and sole tinted yellowish, so some details differ from the original. This is a slight, regenerated look.
Slightly smooth, rendered look with softened detail.

summary: Clean product shot of the same sneaker on a seamless light grey backdrop with a soft shadow, but the background is grey rather than white and the shoe's interior and sole were slightly recolored to cream.
